scope: Exact release source notices and union of Cargo.lock packages; includes build, optional and platform dependencies, not a linked-only inventory. This is an evidence inventory, not a blanket legal certification.
limitations: GCC runtime attribution is supported by pinned GNU/Darwin source inputs, the publisher bottle recipe, and matching file-backed Mach-O sections between the official bottle and SciPy wheel. Physical sleep, final notarization and clean-machine release installation are separate acceptance checks.
